neighbours.label: verbs of correcting or making up for an error or shortfall (compensate, correct, offset)
fire: A wider aperture can compensate for the dim light in the room.
The autopilot will correct for crosswinds during landing.
Extra sleep on weekends does not make up for lost rest.
The editor uses spell-check to correct typos as you type.
Tax credits help offset the higher cost of solar panels.
Parity bits let the receiver correct single errors in transmission.
Strong legs can compensate for a weak ankle when running.
The lens software will correct the barrel distortion in each photo.
quiet: A wider aperture lets in more of the dim light in the room.
The autopilot will fly through crosswinds during landing.
Extra sleep on weekends is common among students.
The editor uses spell-check to underline typos as you type.
Tax credits are available for the cost of solar panels.
Parity bits are sent along with each byte in transmission.
Strong legs are useful for running on rough ground.
The lens software will display the barrel distortion in each photo.
